description:
Activate High Market by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron, gaining 1 life.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, costing you {4} to return Palinchron to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to Palinchron.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping High Market and up to six lands you control that can produce at least {5}.
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Repeat.
